Introductory Prakrit

An online course of six sessions in Prakrit grammar and reading

On request

Arranged for your group. Send your preferred dates, group size and location. We adapt the length, level and language, and prepare a quotation. The suggested group size is a guide, not a requirement.

Request on WhatsApp Request by email

No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

Prakrit was the everyday speech of much of ancient India and the language of Aśoka's edicts. The course covers the essentials of grammar, with guided reading of short passages.

The course is run for your batch on dates you choose. Timings, pace and assessment are agreed before it begins.

What it covers

  • The sounds and basic grammar of Prakrit
  • Guided reading of short passages
  • Where Prakrit is found: inscriptions, drama and Jain texts

Course outline

  1. Sounds and scripts

    Variation in Middle Indo-Aryan and orthographic conventions.

    You: letter table

  2. Grammar basics

    Inflection and verbal forms via short texts.

    You: parsing

  3. Guided reading

    Simple edited Prakrit passage.

    You: translation notes

  4. Review

    Source dating and regional variation.

    You: reading exercise

  5. Practice clinic

    Guided practice on an instructor-selected edited passage or image with vocabulary notes.

    You: correct reading and translation attempts

  6. Progress assessment

    Consolidate script/grammar patterns and discuss regional/textual variations.

    You: submit short annotated reading

The number and length of sessions are agreed with your batch.

You take away

A portfolio of your work from each session.
